name: @howells/ai
description: Unified AI client for all projects — Gateway, OpenRouter, direct providers, tiered language models, and retrieval models.

scripts.check: pnpm check-types && pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm benchmark:build

scripts.lint:fix: howells-oxfmt --write src test apps/benchmark tsdown.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml oxlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts README.md && howells-oxlint --fix --config=oxlint.config.ts src test apps/benchmark tsdown.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml oxlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts
scripts.format: howells-oxfmt --write src test apps/benchmark tsdown.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml oxlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts README.md
